channel.title: Mundo Tuni blog
channel.description: Sourced guides for families with kids ages 2 to 6: counting, colors, shapes, letters, language, screen time and games at home.

item.title: My Child Understands Spanish but Answers in English: What to Do
item.description: Your child understands Spanish but answers in English? What research links to speaking, what CHSA says is normal, and when to ask a specialist.

item.title: Colors and Numbers in Spanish: Play Ideas for Toddlers
item.description: Colors and numbers in Spanish for toddlers: words with both accents (Spain and Latin America), what to expect by age, and easy games with no flashcards.

item.title: Bilingual Speech Delay: Do Two Languages Cause It?
item.description: Does raising a bilingual child cause a speech delay? What CHSA/ASHA and the AAP say, how much mixing is normal and when to ask for an evaluation.

item.title: First Spanish Words for Toddlers: Where to Start
item.description: Which Spanish words to teach toddlers first? A short list by theme, both accents (Spain and Latin America), and ways to use the words in daily play.

item.title: How to Help Your Toddler’s Language Development Through Play
item.description: How to help toddler language development through play: follow their lead, take turns and wait. CDC milestones, sample questions and when to ask for help.

item.title: How to Choose an Educational App for Kids Ages 2 to 6: 8 Questions
item.description: How to choose an educational app for a toddler or preschooler: eight questions on ads, rewards, autoplay and data, based on the AAP’s 2026 policy.

item.title: Kindergarten Readiness: Early Math and Literacy at Home
item.description: What kindergarten readiness means, what the CDC lists at age 5 for numbers and letters, what research links to later learning, and how to practice at home.

item.title: Raising Bilingual Kids in the US: Keeping Spanish Alive at Home
item.description: Raising bilingual children in the US? What Pew data shows about Spanish fading across generations and what research links to kids speaking it.

item.title: Screen-Free Car Games for Toddlers and Preschoolers (and Waiting Rooms)
item.description: Screen-free car games for toddlers and preschoolers, plus ideas for waiting rooms and flights, with the AAP’s tips on breaks, car sickness and travel.

item.title: Screen Time for Toddlers: What the AAP and the WHO Say Now
item.description: How much screen time for toddlers? The AAP’s 2026 policy and the WHO’s one-hour limit side by side, plus the 5 C’s and what to check in an app.

item.title: Spain or Latin American Spanish: Which for Your Child?
item.description: Spanish from Spain or Latin American Spanish for your child? What really differs, what we can’t claim, and how to choose by family, community and travel.

item.title: How to Teach Counting to Toddlers and Preschoolers
item.description: How to teach counting to toddlers and preschoolers: what counting really involves, what the CDC lists at age 5, and games for everyday routines at home.

item.title: How to Teach Your Toddler Spanish If You Don’t Speak It
item.description: Teach your toddler Spanish even if you don’t speak it: what research says about exposure and live interaction, plus simple daily routines to try.
